messages:
alex: quick sync — i pushed a proto for simplifying the left nav. idea: collapse Models + Deployments + Jobs into a single 'Workloads' group to reduce depth. breadcrumbs still show Model > Version or Deployment > Pod when you drill in. want feedback on deep links and copy before i file a PR

morgan: i like reducing churn in the left nav. question: does 'Workloads' hide important distinctions? how do we handle pages that are heavily model-first vs infra-first?

ria: +1 to fewer top-level items. maybe we keep a short label on the top of the content pane that indicates the resource type (e.g., "Model — foo") so context isn't lost when nav is collapsed

sam: copy nit: 'Workloads' sounds infra-y. alternatives: 'Compute', 'Serves', 'Deployments & Models' (ugh). maybe test with product micro-survey?

noah: accessibility nits: ensure breadcrumb has aria-current for the last crumb, and the nav grouping buttons are keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring. also screenreader text for collapsed group toggle ("Expand Workloads navigation")

morgan: deep-linking note: we need stable route contracts for third-party links. proposal: use a canonical path pattern: /workloads/:kind(model|deployment|job)/:id(/:subresource) so external links are predictable

alex: thanks — that's what i sketched. example routes in the prototype:```
/workloads/model/m-123
/workloads/deployment/d-77/instances
/workloads/job/j-4/logs
``` 

ria: small UX concern: when you land on /workloads/model/m-123 we should surface a lightweight header that lets you jump to related deployments or runs. otherwise users get lost in a generic 'workloads' shell

sam: copy proposal for the left nav group label: keep 'Workloads' in the code but surface as 'Models & Deployments' in the UI tooltip. reduces perceived techiness while keeping the single group name for routes

noah: accessibility check for deep links: ensure focus management on route change — focus the H1, not the nav. otherwise screenreader users won't know content changed. also update skip links so they point to the main content id when deep-linking into subpages

alex: good recs. i'll add aria-current, visible focus styles, and explicit focus-on-route-change to the proto. sam — i like your tooltip approach, can you draft the tooltip copy?

sam: sure — draft options: "Models & Deployments", "Models, Deployments & Jobs", "AI Workloads". lean toward #1 for clarity

morgan: small product ask: on the breadcrumb pattern, can we include a fallback crumb when resource has no parent (e.g., 'Models > Unknown Version') so breadcrumbs never collapse to nothing

alex: yeah we'll render a placeholder crumb with text '—' and aria-hidden on the placeholder link, plus a tooltip explaining absence of parent. i'll update the prototype tonight and DM screenshots

design-bot: prototype updated: https://figma.redwood/workloads-nav-v2 (comment thread created) :eyes:

ria: will review screens. quick QA checklist idea for the PR: keyboard nav, aria-current, focus on route change, deep-link examples in e2e, tooltip copy doc

alex: perfect. i'll wire tests for deep-link anchors and add the QA checklist to the PR template. thanks all :thumbsup:
